about: Hand labels for the questions judged 'different' from the reference in all three runs (written sets reps 11-13, published p11-p13). Evidence: rerun_reference.py (variants the reference script prints), plans and scripts read by hand. Labelled 2026-11-25.

labels.self_loop_convention: our value equals the value the reference script itself prints for 'self-loops excluded'
labels.other_reading: our value equals another variant the reference lists
labels.open_choice: the question leaves a choice open (cut-off, bins, group) and the two systems chose differently
labels.random_algorithm: randomised or sampled algorithm; values are not expected to match
labels.ours_wrong: GraphAudit answers another question than the one asked
labels.reference_wrong: the reference contradicts its own earlier turns
